decision_type: prospective for unexecuted Stage 3 inference; informed by already observed validation evidence, not pre-data registration
supersedes_for_future_release_only: original Stage 3 MIN numerical gate and Stage 3A mechanism-demonstration prerequisite

game_records.scope: same preserved Stage 3A 53-player-season audit; no claim of league-wide game validation
game_records.identity: exact player, season, game ID and date
game_records.appearance_sets: exact recorded appearance sets and GP
game_records.minutes: exact displayed MM:SS at finest successfully retrieved public whole-second precision
game_records.missing_DNP: retain separately; never convert to recorded zero
game_records.unobserved_DNP: absence from appearance-only logs remains missing official evidence; no independent DNP claim

eligibility.rule: positive total time at player-season level; aggregate all recorded appearances including 0:00 for an eligible season
eligibility.scope: all 1510 preserved official/archive season comparisons, plus all 53 audited game reconstructions

season_decimal_MIN.mechanism_claim: unknown; no claim of true unrounded time, simple rounding, truncation, or hidden raw-minute equality

other_mandatory_gates: unchanged candidate hashes and expected panel accounting
no Stage 3 scientific association examined before adoption
limitation_required_in_all_future_stage3: Public NBA game-level minute displays and the archived game records agreed at the available whole-second resolution in the audited sample, while small discrepancies remained between summed game displays and NBA season-level decimal minute displays. Because season-level MIN was not the scientific outcome, exposure, or primary model predictor, and because shooting counts and analytical eligibility reconciled, the amended prospective validation protocol treated season-total MIN as an ancillary representation field rather than an exact numerical release gate. The internal NBA aggregation mechanism remains unknown.
